 <blockquote class="pp-doctor-quote">
 <p><em>The distress of excessive sweating is real, and many people suffer for years before finding a solution. Tap water iontophoresis is a basic, non-invasive treatment for hyperhidrosis: no needles, no systemic drugs. It uses a mild electrical current to reduce overactive sweat gland function. The DermaDry Total is suitable for home treatment of palms, soles and underarms.</em></p>
 </blockquote>

 <!-- 2b. STRUKTURÁLT KIVONAT – elvárás, kizárás, konzultáció -->
 <dl class="pp-trust-facts" style="margin:16px 0 0;padding:14px 18px;background:#f4f8fc;border-left:4px solid #0055a5;border-radius:6px;">

 <dt style="margin:0 0 3px;font-weight:700;color:#0055a5;font-size:0.95em;">
 <img src="https://www.medimarket.com/shop_ordered/21500/pic/emotic/celpont.png" alt="" style="height:22px;width:auto;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:6px;">Realistic expectations
 </dt>
 <dd style="margin:0 0 12px;line-height:1.55;color:#333;">Iontophoresis is a course-based method. Treat once daily for two weeks, then switch to maintenance once or twice weekly. The effect is not permanent. Sweating may gradually return — then a new intensive course is indicated. Finding the right current and session time usually takes a few attempts.</dd>

 <dt style="margin:0 0 3px;font-weight:700;color:#0055a5;font-size:0.95em;">
 <img src="https://www.medimarket.com/shop_ordered/21500/pic/emotic/figyelmeztetes.png" alt="" style="height:22px;width:auto;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:6px;">This is not the device for you if
 </dt>
 <dd style="margin:0 0 12px;line-height:1.55;color:#333;">If you need a device for joint pain or for delivering medication, the dual-function IontoBravo (which supports drug-carrying iontophoresis) is more suitable. If sweating started suddenly or occurs at night, further medical evaluation is required first.</dd>

 <dt style="margin:0 0 3px;font-weight:700;color:#0055a5;font-size:0.95em;">
 <img src="https://shop.unas.hu/shop_ordered/21500/pic/emotic/tens-elektroda.png" alt="" style="height:22px;width:auto;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:6px;">Before you order
 </dt>
 <dd style="margin:0;line-height:1.55;color:#333;">Sudden, nocturnal or one-sided sweating can be a sign of underlying disease — have it checked by a dermatologist or internist. This product description gives general guidance on treatment duration and frequency. If you are uncertain, or you have chronic illness or take medications, consult your treating physician before starting. DO NOT use with a pacemaker or defibrillator, during pregnancy, over metal implants in the treatment area, with arrhythmia, epilepsy, or where there is an open wound or infection in the treatment area.</dd>

 </dl>

 <footer>
 <p><strong>– <a href="https://www.medimarket.com/about-dr-zsolt-zatrok">Dr. Zsolt Zátrok</a></strong><br />

 <!-- 3. CÉLCSOPORTOK / KINEK AJÁNLOM? -->
 <section class="pp-target-segments">
 <h2 class="pp-headline">When is it recommended?</h2>
 <div class="pp-accordion">
 <div class="pp-accordion-item"><input type="checkbox" id="pp_acc_1" class="pp-accordion-checkbox"> <label for="pp_acc_1" class="pp-accordion-label"> <img src="https://shop.unas.hu/shop_ordered/21500/pic/emotic/tenyer-izzadas.png" alt="palm-sweating" style="height: 32px; width: auto;"> <span class="pp-accordion-title">If sweaty palms interfere with your work</span> <span class="pp-accordion-arrow">▼</span> </label>
 <div class="pp-accordion-content">
 <p>Severe palmar sweating can be embarrassing during handshakes, when holding paper, or when using sensitive electronic devices. For many people, palmar hyperhidrosis significantly limits daily activities. Iontophoresis is a method specifically developed and scientifically validated for palmar hyperhidrosis – significant improvement is generally observed after 1–3 weeks of regular treatment.</p>
 </div>
 </div>
 <div class="pp-accordion-item"><input type="checkbox" id="pp_acc_2" class="pp-accordion-checkbox"> <label for="pp_acc_2" class="pp-accordion-label"> <img src="https://shop.unas.hu/shop_ordered/21500/pic/emotic/talp-izzadas.png" alt="sole-sweating" style="height: 32px; width: auto;"> <span class="pp-accordion-title">If your feet sweat heavily – prevent shoe odor and fungal infections</span> <span class="pp-accordion-arrow">▼</span> </label>
 <div class="pp-accordion-content">
 <p>Heavy foot sweating can cause unpleasant odor and increase susceptibility to fungal infections. Sweating can be so intense that your foot slides in the slipper. The DermaDry Total works with a maximum current of 25 mA for foot treatment – reliably reducing moisture. Nightly maintenance sessions can be particularly effective.</p>
 </div>
 </div>
 <div class="pp-accordion-item"><input type="checkbox" id="pp_acc_3" class="pp-accordion-checkbox"> <label for="pp_acc_3" class="pp-accordion-label"> <img src="https://shop.unas.hu/shop_ordered/21500/pic/emotic/honalj-izzadas.png" alt="axilla-sweating" style="height: 32px; width: auto;"> <span class="pp-accordion-title">Do you have a large sweat stain under your arm?</span> <span class="pp-accordion-arrow">▼</span> </label>
 <div class="pp-accordion-content">
 <p>Axillary hyperhidrosis causes heavy soaking of clothing, which can be socially uncomfortable and lead to low self-confidence and social difficulties. The DermaDry Total operates at a lower current (8 mA) for underarm treatment – the device's specific electrodes ensure precise treatment. Although axillary treatment can take a bit longer, persistent users report positive results.</p>
 </div>
 </div>
 <div class="pp-accordion-item"><input type="checkbox" id="pp_acc_4" class="pp-accordion-checkbox"> <label for="pp_acc_4" class="pp-accordion-label"> <img src="https://shop.unas.hu/shop_ordered/21500/pic/emotic/doktor-bacsi.png" alt="doctor" style="height: 32px; width: auto;"> <span class="pp-accordion-title">Treatment based on medical recommendation</span> <span class="pp-accordion-arrow">▼</span> </label>
 <div class="pp-accordion-content">
 <p>If cosmetics or powders don't help (they rarely do), physicians should first recommend iontophoresis instead of more invasive and substantially more expensive treatments (botox or surgery). The DermaDry Total offers a non-invasive home alternative – and is cost-effective. Botulinum toxin injections need repeating every 4–6 months; surgery can have permanent side effects – iontophoresis, however, can be used long-term with minimal risk.</p>
 </div>
 </div>
 <div class="pp-accordion-item"><input type="checkbox" id="pp_acc_5" class="pp-accordion-checkbox"> <label for="pp_acc_5" class="pp-accordion-label"> <img src="https://shop.unas.hu/shop_ordered/21500/pic/emotic/hordozhato-keszulek.png" alt="maintenance" style="height: 32px; width: auto;"> <span class="pp-accordion-title">Maintenance treatment – prevent recurrence</span> <span class="pp-accordion-arrow">▼</span> </label>
 <div class="pp-accordion-content">
 <p>Iontophoresis effects are not permanent – sweating may increase again after two to three months. After a course, switching to maintenance treatment is recommended: treat once or twice weekly. The DermaDry Total is ideal for long-term maintenance because it can be used anytime at home and treatments are not time-consuming.</p>
 </div>
 </div>
 <div class="pp-accordion-item"><input type="checkbox" id="pp_acc_6" class="pp-accordion-checkbox"> <label for="pp_acc_6" class="pp-accordion-label"> <img src="https://shop.unas.hu/shop_ordered/21500/pic/emotic/lany-fiu.png" alt="from-teens" style="height: 32px; width: auto;"> <span class="pp-accordion-title">From adolescents to adults – age-independent use</span> <span class="pp-accordion-arrow">▼</span> </label>
 <div class="pp-accordion-content">
 <p>The manufacturer recommends the device from age 13. Simple reason: the treatment should be performed by someone who understands and cooperates with the process. For small children, medical consultation is required and a parent must be present during treatment. Iontophoresis can be effective for adolescents and adults alike, especially when hyperhidrosis causes psychological burden. Consult your physician about age suitability and a personalized protocol.</p>
 </div>
 </div>
 </div>
 </section>
 <!-- 5. HOGYAN MŰKÖDIK? (Hatásmechanizmus) -->
 <section class="pp-how-it-works">
 <h2 class="pp-headline">How does iontophoresis work?</h2>
 <p>Iontophoresis is a long-known, non-invasive procedure. During treatment the device conducts a mild electric current through tap water to the skin surface. This current influences the activity of the sweat glands.</p>
 <p>The exact mechanism is still under research, but scientific literature suggests several processes may play a role: temporary blockage of sweat gland ducts and raising the threshold for sweat-triggering stimuli.</p>
 <h3>Automatic device functions:</h3>
 <ul>
 <li>Polarity switching during treatment (no manual switching required)</li>
 <li>Safety current limiting</li>
 <li>Child lock function (3-second start)</li>
 </ul>
 <h3>What can users expect?</h3>
 <p>Iontophoresis effectiveness depends on individual factors and treatment regularity. Based on clinical studies:</p>
 <ul>
 <li>Mild tingling may be felt during initial treatments – this is normal</li>
 <li>With regular, protocol-based use, a large proportion of users experience significant improvement</li>
 <li>Randomized, controlled trials indicate that tap water iontophoresis can effectively reduce palmar sweating</li>
 <li>According to a systematic review, after 1–4 weeks of regular treatment a <strong>30–90% reduction in sweating</strong> can be observed, which may persist for weeks–months with maintenance treatments</li>
 </ul>
 <div class="pp-info-box">
 <div><strong>Important:</strong> Results vary. Degree of improvement depends on sweat severity, treatment regularity and individual responsiveness. Iontophoresis does not replace medical consultation.</div>
 </div>
 </section>

 <!-- 7. FAQ SZEKCIÓ – NATÍV HTML5 RADIO BUTTON ELEMEKKEL (v3.0) -->
 <section class="pp-faq-section">
 <h2 class="pp-headline">Frequently asked questions</h2>
 <div class="pp-faq-item"><input type="radio" name="pp_faq" id="pp_faq_1" class="pp-faq-radio"> <label for="pp_faq_1" class="pp-faq-label"> What age can the device be used from? </label>
 <div class="pp-faq-body">
 <p>The manufacturer recommends the device from age 13. For younger users medical consultation is advised.</p>
 </div>
 </div>
 <div class="pp-faq-item"><input type="radio" name="pp_faq" id="pp_faq_2" class="pp-faq-radio"> <label for="pp_faq_2" class="pp-faq-label"> Is the treatment painful? </label>
 <div class="pp-faq-body">
 <p>A mild tingling is felt during treatment. If uncomfortable, reduce the current. The device supports gradual current adjustment.</p>
 </div>
 </div>
 <div class="pp-faq-item"><input type="radio" name="pp_faq" id="pp_faq_3" class="pp-faq-radio"> <label for="pp_faq_3" class="pp-faq-label"> How often should it be used? </label>
 <div class="pp-faq-body">
 <p>The detailed protocol is in the included manual. Generally, once daily for 2–3 weeks, then as maintenance once or twice weekly is recommended. If sweating increases, start a new intensive course.</p>
 </div>
 </div>
 <div class="pp-faq-item"><input type="radio" name="pp_faq" id="pp_faq_4" class="pp-faq-radio"> <label for="pp_faq_4" class="pp-faq-label"> Can it be taken on trips? Allowed on planes?</label>
 <div class="pp-faq-body">
 <p>Yes, the device is compact and portable. For travel regulations, check the current airline rules regarding electronic devices.</p>
 </div>
 </div>
 <div class="pp-faq-item"><input type="radio" name="pp_faq" id="pp_faq_5" class="pp-faq-radio"> <label for="pp_faq_5" class="pp-faq-label"> What happens if the water runs out? </label>
 <div class="pp-faq-body">
 <p>The device does not evaporate the water, so it won't "run out" during a 15–20 minute session. Treatment cannot proceed without water because the device has circuit detection. Without water it will not detect the proper circuit and will not start.</p>
 </div>
 </div>
 <div class="pp-faq-item"><input type="radio" name="pp_faq" id="pp_faq_6" class="pp-faq-radio"> <label for="pp_faq_6" class="pp-faq-label"> How long until results are seen? </label>
 <div class="pp-faq-body">
 <p>Results vary and depend on sweat severity. Clinical studies report many users notice significant improvement after 2–3 weeks. Some see results sooner (1–2 weeks), others later (4+ weeks).</p>
 </div>
 </div>
 <div class="pp-faq-item"><input type="radio" name="pp_faq" id="pp_faq_7" class="pp-faq-radio"> <label for="pp_faq_7" class="pp-faq-label"> How long does the effect of iontophoresis last? </label>
 <div class="pp-faq-body">
 <p>The effect of an iontophoresis course is not permanent. Generally sweating may increase again after a few weeks–months. The intensive course should then be repeated. Maintenance treatment is recommended: after a 2–3 week course, do not stop treatments completely but reduce frequency to 1–2 times weekly to maintain results longer.</p>
 </div>
 </div>
 </section>

 <!-- 12. ELLENJAVALLATOK – MedicalDevice inline mikrodata -->
 <section class="pp-contraindication-list">
 <h2 class="pp-headline"><img src="https://shop.unas.hu/shop_ordered/21500/pic/emotic/tiltas.png" alt="Important" style="height: 32px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle; margin-right: 8px;">Important information before use</h2>
 <h3>When NOT to use the device?</h3>
 <p>Do NOT use the device if:</p>
 <ul>
 <li>You have an implanted pacemaker or defibrillator</li>
 <li>You are pregnant</li>
 <li>There is a metallic implant in the treatment area</li>
 <li>You have an arrhythmia</li>
 <li>You have epilepsy</li>
 <li>There is an open wound or infection in the treatment area</li>
 </ul>
 <p><em>If in doubt, consult your treating physician!</em></p>
 <h3>Possible side effects</h3>
 <p>During treatment the following may occur:</p>
 <ul>
 <li>Mild tingling sensation (this is normal)</li>
 <li>Transient redness of the treated area</li>
 <li>Rarely: small blisters (if current is set too high)</li>
 <li>Dry skin (moisturize after treatment)</li>
 </ul>
 <p>If this is uncomfortable, reduce the current. For persistent or unusual symptoms stop treatment and consult your doctor.</p>
 </section>

 <!-- 13. VÍZ MINŐSÉGI ÚTMUTATÓ -->
 <section>
 <h2 class="pp-headline">About water quality</h2>
 <p>The device operates with tap water. Mineral content of water may vary by location. If your tap water is too soft (low conductivity), try the following:</p>
 <ul>
 <li>Add 1 teaspoon of baking soda or table salt</li>
 <li>Use bottled mineral water</li>
 </ul>
 <div class="pp-warning-box" style="background: #fff3e0; border-left: 4px solid #ff9800; padding: 12px 16px; margin: 15px 0; border-radius: 4px; display: flex; gap: 12px;"><img src="https://shop.unas.hu/shop_ordered/21500/pic/emotic/figyelmeztetes.png" alt="Warning" style="height: 32px; width: auto; flex-shrink: 0;">
 <div><strong>Important:</strong> Never use softened or distilled water!</div>
 </div>
 </section>
